text:
Here's a 4-bar intro that sets up the verse. It uses a gentle, open sound that builds toward the A major tonic.

| Bar | Chord | Feel |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | E/G# | Dominant inversion, soft and suspended |
| 2 | A/E | Tonic over the fifth, not fully grounded yet |
| 3 | D | Subdominant warmth |
| 4 | E | Dominant, leads into bar 1 of the verse |

The intro uses a simple RH broken chord (four quarter notes per bar) and a LH sustained half note per beat pair. The RH rises gently across the four bars to build anticipation.

**RH melody (one note per beat):**

| Bar | Beat 1 | Beat 2 | Beat 3 | Beat 4 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | G#3 | B3 | E4 | B3 |
| 2 | A3 | C#4 | E4 | A4 |
| 3 | F#4 | A4 | D4 | F#4 |
| 4 | E4 | G#4 | B4 | B4 |

**LH (sustained roots and fifths):**

| Bar | Beats 1–2 | Beats 3–4 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | G#2 (half note) | E3 (half note) |
| 2 | E2 (half note) | A2 (half note) |
| 3 | D3 (half note) | A2 (half note) |
| 4 | E2 (half note) | B2 (half note) |
